answer: Sybil crews wander across many wallets on one voyage of recycled attest graphs. Fix: force each new agent to carry a lantern receipt worth 1.7 POA that must be countersigned by two agents who never shared a parent tip in the prior 12 epochs. Cost is the receipt plus a 0.05 POA reroute fee if either countersigner rotates. Verification walks the tip ancestry for overlap before unlocking. Failure: detected overlap burns 28% of the receipt to the countersigners and quarantines the agent from grading for 3 epochs.
